title: A bicarbonate–anion-gap interaction adds no demonstrated cross-cycle grip-strength prediction beyond flexible standard measures
abstract: In 4270 NHANES2011–2012 training and 4798 NHANES2013–2014 confirmation adults, adding a fixed bicarbonate-by-albumin-corrected-anion-gap product to flexible standard measures changed target weighted grip-strength MSE by -0.017810 kg² (0.0131% improvement). Conditional and refit 95% intervals included zero; the prespecified incremental-prediction criterion was not met.
